clarity.justification: The procedure is aligned with the question and specifies what is varied and measured: it will "add alpha*direction to activations," sweep alpha, and compare the resulting output shifts against "correlate-control edits" and "random-direction edits." The prediction is directional and therefore refutable for an individual mechanism—failure to obtain the "law-predicted direction and magnitude," monotonicity, or superiority to controls would count against it—but the aggregate claim that "many" mechanisms fail has no definition of many, pass threshold, or fully specified formula for the combined Mechanism Fidelity Score. Moreover, calibration of edit magnitude is ambiguous because the plan does not define how arbitrary activation-space alpha maps onto physical units, and a probe direction may bundle confounds rather than uniquely denote the claimed mechanistic variable, so the proposed causal interpretation requires clarification.

feasibility.justification: The hardest step is to "identify a confound variable that correlates in-distribution but is causally irrelevant" and construct "paired sequences differing only in the mechanistic variable" for each domain; this is not an impossible magic step, but it is specialized dataset design whose matching and causal-validity procedure remains underspecified. The named artifacts ESM-2, ProTherm/FireProtDB, MegaScale ddG, SKEMPI, and Materials Project exist, and linear probes, forward activation edits, patching, Spearman metrics, and random-direction controls have standard tooling; however, "a public chemistry transformer," "public mRNA stability sets," and the prediction heads converting foundation-model activations into "stability/affinity/yield" outputs are not concretely selected or defined. Resources receive partial credit for "~10 established mechanisms" and "ESM-2 8M->650M," while dataset sample sizes and most model identities are left generic. The correlate, random-direction, paired-input, naturally decorrelated-subset, and off-manifold controls make a negative result runnable, although the missing output-head and matching specifications leave material implementation work.
